notes: Linked the Reports 'Tinh trang xu ly ghi nhan loi' dashboard to Nhat ky loi. Backend: added classifyViolationWorkflowStatus (lib/checklist-violations.js), a shared classifier reused by both getChecklistViolationWorkflowSummary (lib/checklist-reports.js, replacing its inline loop with identical output) and a new workflowStatus filter + per-row workflowStatus field on listChecklistViolations - same waiting_employee/in_explanation/overdue/official/cancelled buckets already defined for the KPI summary, no new business rule. Also added canViewViolations to getChecklistRoleWorkspace (lib/checklist-permissions.js), exposing the existing view_violations capability that requireViolationPermission(session,'view') already checks but the manager route guard/sidebar never read - managers with view_violations but not record_violation (e.g. Quan ly truc tiep) can now open Nhat ky lỗi read-only (no record/Excel buttons), matching backend permission instead of being blocked by the stricter canRecordViolation-only gate. Frontend: replaced the old technical 'Trang thai' (active/cancelled/all) filter on Nhat ky loi with a single business-facing 'Tinh trang xu ly' filter (Tat ca/Cho nhan vien phan hoi/Dang giai trinh/Qua han phan hoi/Da chinh thuc/Da huy); record_status still drives the query, just derived automatically instead of picked separately. Each row now shows its workflow status as a sub-label (was 'Dang hieu luc/Da huy'), and the 6 Dashboard KPI tiles are clickable (role=button on the existing <article>, no CSS-breaking tag change) - navigate to Nhat ky loi via ?workflowStatus=<key> query param, read back by violationsHtml() on every render so deep links, back/forward and the click-through all funnel through one seeding point.
